summary: Create Purchase Order Contract detail line item
description: Creates a Detail Line Item on a given Purchase Order Contract Line Item

contract_detail_line_item.description: Attributes of the Detail Line Item to create or update.

line_item_id.description: ID of the parent contract Line Item this Detail Line Item belongs to.

amount.description: Contract amount allocated to this Detail Line Item, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

description.description: Free-text description of the work or cost this Detail Line Item covers.
